title: Event-driven token emission audit pipeline for cost & latency attribution
creator: Aisha Kumar
description:
Goal: build an eventized audit pipeline that records per-token emission events (micro-timings + cache delta) so we can attribute latency and cost to tokens and cache behavior without adding blocking overhead to request paths. Deliver a schematized token_event_v1 stream, an aggregation job to roll up per-request and per-customer cost-by-token, and console dashboards + alerts for regressions.

Design highlights and trade-offs:
- Emit lightweight token events from two hooks in the runtime: pre-emit (kv lookup start/end) and post-emit (kernel exec end). Events are appended asynchronously to a local write-ahead buffer and flushed to Kafka to avoid tail latency impact.
- Schema balances fidelity vs volume: include request_id, trace_id, model_variant, model_version, host_shard, seq_index, token_text (hashed), token_byte_len, kv_hit (boolean), kv_lookup_ms, kernel_exec_ms, emission_timestamp_ns, batch_size, sampled (boolean). Full token text is hashed to avoid PII in the stream.
- Sampling policy: default is full capture for enterprise customers and sampling (1%) for public-tier requests. Sampling config is per-route in the routing policy.
- Cost attribution algorithm: per-token compute-ms = kernel_exec_ms / batch_effective_multiplier; effective token cost adjusted by kv_hit weight. Kv_hit reduces marginal cost attribution; we store both observed and adjusted cost so downstream billing/analytics can choose conservative or optimistic views.
- Aggregation: Kafka -> Flink job that dedups by (request_id, seq_index), enriches with model cost profiles (from runtime-config), emits per-request summaries and daily rollups to Redshift/BigQuery. Also write high-cardinality low-latency rollups to Datadog for dashboards.
- Privacy & retention: token events retained 7 days in raw stream, 365 days for aggregated rollups. Raw token_text is not stored; only hash and byte_len.

Acceptance criteria:
- token_event_v1 emitted from runtime for >=99% of non-sampled requests without increasing p90 tail by >5ms.
- Deduped per-request summaries available in analytics store within 10 minutes.
- Console has per-route and per-model token latency and kv-hit impact dashboards (initial set).
- Regression alert fires when median per-token kernel_exec_ms increases >15% vs baseline for a model variant.

Rollout plan:
1) Instrument runtime hooks behind feature flag and enable for internal customers.
2) Bring up Kafka topic and Flink aggregator in staging.
3) Validate end-to-end and run A/B on controlled traffic.
4) Gradual enable for customers (enterprise first), monitor cost of event volume and tune sampling.

2026-03-11 - Security (Liu Chen): reviewed schema; request to add a field 'sampled' and to confirm no raw text flows into persistent analytics. Security asked for retention policy to be codified in infra runbooks.
